title: NETSCOUT Reaches Innovation Milestone With 750th Patent
summary: Industry Innovator Delivers Powerful Solutions for Customers Over Four Decades NETSCOUT ® (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of observability, AIOps, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection solutions, today celebrates the issuance of its 750 th patent. The patent, “Systems and Methods for Performing Computer Network Service Chain Analysis,” issued June 24, 2026, in the U.K., is the latest in a portfolio that spans NETSCOUT’s long record of continuous innovation, from deep packet inspection to adaptive DDoS mitigation, from 5G service assurance to AI-ready data platforms, from on premises to cloud-native observability. Guided by a philosophy of unrelenting commitment to its customers and to innovation, NETSCOUT has built an intellectual property portfolio, patent by patent and invention by invention, across technology cycles in the networking and cybersecurity industries. “Our 750th patent is a milestone we are proud of, but what it represents matters more than the number itself,”
